name: create_subtype
description: Create a reusable location subtype template (for example tavern or wizard tower) and return its ID. Prefer reusing an existing subtype when one already fits. Key is stored lowercase.

key.description: Subtype slug, for example tavern. Stored lowercase.

type.description: Location type this subtype applies to.

expected_tags.description: Tags commonly associated with this subtype.

description.description: Short description of how the subtype is used.
